LanguageData.LCOrdeal_AmberQuote: A perfect meal, an excellent substitute.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_CrimsonQuote: Let us light a flame yet more radiant in our lives; for life is a candlelight, destined to snuff out one day.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_GreenQuote: One day, a question crossed through my mind. Where do we come from? We were given life and left in this world against our own volition.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_VioletQuote: To gain an understanding of what is incomprehensible, they dream, staring.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_AmberEndQuote: We ate incessantly to live. The inevitable diminution, the waste…
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_CrimsonEndQuote: To live is to yearn and fight for our desires.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_GreenEndQuote: To live was a process full of pain.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_VioletEndQuote: They complied with nothing in their bid to understand. They simply did so.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_AmberFailureText: The Ordeal was not suppressed within the allotted time.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_CrimsonFailureText: The Ordeal was not suppressed within the allotted time.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_GreenFailureText: The Ordeal was not suppressed within the allotted time.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_VioletFailureText: The Ordeal was not suppressed within the allotted time.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonCrimsonQuote: We marched from time to time, and we would share our pleasure.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonCrimsonEndQuote: The collision of one life with another, skin harmonizing, painting a yet more beautiful appearance.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonGreenQuote: In the end, they were bound to life. We existed only to express despair and ire.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonGreenEndQuote: We will understand life and the soul with our own hands.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonVioletQuote: We could only hear the weakest and faintest of their acts. We sought for love and compassion from them.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonVioletEndQuote: We cannot understand them, nor will they understand us.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonIndigoQuote: When night falls in the Backstreets, they will come.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonIndigoEndQuote: When the sun rises, there will be no trace of them.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_NoonFailureText: The Ordeal was not suppressed within the allotted time.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_DuskAmberQuote: To accustom oneself to the taste was an inevitable process.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_DuskAmberEndQuote: We could live. We could continue eating.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_DuskCrimsonQuote: Throwing away our old bodies, we all become one, infinitely continuing the red march.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_DuskCrimsonEndQuote: One day we will know, and tomorrow we will march hand in hand.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_DuskGreenQuote: We constructed a looming tower to return whence we came.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_DuskGreenEndQuote: There wasn’t an answer. We didn’t find a single thing we wanted. We only witnessed the death of life itself.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_DuskFailureText: The Ordeal was not suppressed within the allotted time.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_MidnightAmberQuote: They fought amongst themselves to eat the others.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_MidnightAmberEndQuote: And the stronger side survived. That, simply, is the story.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_MidnightGreenQuote: The tower is touched by the sky, and nothing will remain on the ground.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_MidnightGreenEndQuote: Who pays for the suffering and neglect of the lives given to us?
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_MidnightVioletQuote: We incessantly tried to accept it. We wanted to understand them in our heads by any means, regardless of the consequences.
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_MidnightVioletEndQuote: For the sake of not crumbling in on oneself. The idea that they may impossibly exist, or that they are unreachable and forever enigmatic no matter the path. Unacceptable…
LanguageData.LCOrdeal_MidnightFailureText: The Ordeal was not suppressed within the allotted time.
